summary: Implemented centralized auth error classification and recovery, hardened logout cleanup (including query cancellation, IndexedDB/ranking cache/sessionStorage clearing, and identity clearing), added notification preferences schema with persistence/backup migration, improved Notifications settings UI and test-notification feedback, and added guards to reduce post-logout background calls. One notable gap: some user-facing error toasts may still surface raw backend error text (potentially containing "Unauthorized").

missing_requirements.requirement: No screen in the app renders the literal strings "Unauthorized" / "Unauthorized User" to the user as an unhandled error; authorization failures must be mapped to clean English UX.
missing_requirements.reason: Settings logout error handling interpolates and displays the raw backend error message string to the user. If the backend error contains "Unauthorized"/"Unauthorized User", this would violate the requirement to never show raw unauthorized text and to instead show the session-expired message.
evidence: frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx (toast.error(`Failed to delete leaderboard data: ${errorMessage}...`) where errorMessage comes from error?.message)

missing_requirements.requirement: Settings → Notifications includes clear English text stating: notifications require browser permission; delivery is not guaranteed when the app/browser is closed; behavior depends on browser support.
missing_requirements.reason: A platform limitations notice is present, but the diff is truncated mid-sentence, so it cannot be confirmed from the provided evidence that it explicitly states delivery is not guaranteed when the app/browser is closed.
evidence: frontend/src/components/settings/NotificationsCard.tsx ("Browser notifications only:" message is truncated: "work only while the app is op...")

hallucinated_features.description: Updated project_state.json summary describes implementing a Firebase Firestore-based global realtime ranking system.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly states Firebase/FCM integration is unsupported and is a non-goal; additionally, this build request focuses on logout/auth error handling and web-notification hardening rather than Firebase-based ranking changes. The modified file content indicates Firebase Firestore goals unrelated to the requested scope.
